instructions:
FreeLlama runs bounded work on local Ollama models so you spend fewer of your own tokens. Offload when what you send plus what you read back costs less than doing the work yourself and the answer is cheap to check: 10 or more similar items, or an input over about 2,000 tokens that you would otherwise read whole. Do it yourself: judgment you must stand behind (security review, design, merge decisions), edits across files, or one short item.

Start with models{view:"catalog", job} (tested picks per job, whether each is installed and fits now; cookbooks at freellama://docs/cookbooks/<job>), and pass that pick as model: routing without model picks by capability only and may choose one that does not fit now. Or pass run_task{workflow} (fix-bug, write-tests, review-code, summarize-log, extract-json, read-fields, describe-screen...) or run_task{job}: FreeLlama picks the model and gives it step-by-step instructions for the task (your fields win). Send one of workflow, job or task: a workflow implies its job and task, and a conflicting job or task is refused. MCP prompts show each workflow's call. Machines differ: when no tested pick is installed, a workflow or job runs on an installed model with the job's capability and a check: line marks it untested, so verify more. fits_now is a conservative preview; serve's memory gate measures the real need. Call doctor{view:"status"} when a call fails or before a large batch. Choose by the capabilities models reports, not by what a tag's name suggests. Keep one model per batch when you can; each extra model is a load and may evict another.

Name inputs with files (paths or globs under the server's working directory, the temp directory or FREELLAMA_FILE_ROOTS); pasted text and base64 images are your own output tokens. One task reads all its files together, so a glob gives one answer; for one answer per file send tasks:[{id, independent:true, task:{files:[path]}}] (up to 64), with what the items share (task, model, systemPrompt, questions, tools, format, options) once at the top level. For a large divisible check (code tree, logs, docs site) use sweep: it judges small chunks in the background, saves each result and reports only flagged or changed chunks. To find which files relate to a text, or duplicate pairs, use run_task{task:"embedding", files, nearest:{query}} (omit query for pairs) instead: one embedding pass, no model call per chunk. Hosts cut calls near 60 s: for a cold load, a long input or a large batch pass defer:true and poll task_jobs{action:"get", jobId} with the job_id it returns (accepted_job_ids for tasks). Warming a model saves local time, not your tokens.

You own prompts, output format and verification: local answers are candidates, so check 3 to 5 (more where a mistake costs more) before relying on the rest, and treat low decision probabilities as unknown (a check: line marks p 0.35 to 0.65).
Memory: a refusal names the programs holding memory; tell the user and never stop their processes, then retry once they free memory, or use a smaller installed model with the same capability.
Approval: before ollama_pull, ask the user for one exact tag (name:tag) and its reported size, and pass that size as approvedSizeBytes; search results are not permission, and a user naming a tag has not yet approved its size. Unload only a model you warmed (when its burst ends) or one the user named; delete only a tag the user names.
Results: check isError first, then read the text: run_task and task_jobs answer with the text, its check: lines and a closing response_file: line; read_response{file, section} opens a receipt field your next step needs (receipt:"full" returns the receipt inline). Other tools also return structuredContent. A long answer (run_task, delegate_research, task_jobs get) comes back as a summary plus the output_file holding it; output:"inline" returns it whole, outputPath picks the file. Pass page.next_cursor (models) and next_offset (read_response) back unchanged. A server restart loses scopes, sessions and jobs; with FREELLAMA_DURABLE_JOBS=1 finished job receipts survive and an unfinished job reports an unknown outcome, never replayed. CPU/GPU placement is operator-configured; executionPreference only chooses among eligible backends. Docs: freellama://docs/index.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Use when: checking Ollama/FreeLlama health, live queues and limits (view:status) or token usage (view:usage). Do not use when: choosing a model (models). Returns: summary (default): versions, resident models, problems; full adds every check; status: live memory, queues, holds and limits; usage: tokens over `days`. endpoint is serve, ollamaEndpoint is Ollama.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Use when: related run_task calls should stay on one model with a warm runner: create returns session_id, pass it as run_task sessionId; kill stops its running tasks, delete forgets it. Do not use when: cancelling one deferred job (task_jobs), keeping history (scope) or freeing memory (ollama_manage unload). Returns: a receipt.

tools.name: models
tools.description: Use when: choosing a model (view:catalog: tested picks per job, what is installed and fits now), listing installed or loaded models, inspecting one, or searching ollama.com and Hugging Face GGUF repos (view:library). Do not use when: running work (run_task) or pulling (ollama_pull). Returns: models; library lists families, then one family's tags.

view.description: installed: tags, capabilities, fit; resident: loaded now, GPU/CPU split; detail: one tag; raw: Ollama /api/tags, paged; library: search (query) or one family's tags

job.description: catalog: one job's measured picks that fit now

model.description: detail: the tag; library: a family or hf.co/owner/repo, to list its tags with sizeBytes

tools.name: scope
tools.description: Use when: a multi-turn local chat should keep its history on the server: create returns scope_id and revision 0; send run_task {scopeId, scopeRevision} (always together), then the next scopeRevision is that result's structuredContent.scope.revision; fork (needs `revision`, the scope's current one) returns a new scope_id at revision 0 with the same history. Do not use when: you only want one model kept warm (session) or a one-shot task. Returns: scope id and revision; history only with includeMessages:true.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Use when: bounded work for a local model: a workflow or job, decision, embedding + `nearest`, vision, tools (returns tool_calls you run). Do not use when: you must stand behind the judgment or need edits across files. `tasks` = up to 64 independent items; per-item fields override top-level defaults (workflow and job apply to the whole batch); one `model` per batch avoids a cold load per model; `maxParallelism` caps dispatch; `preview:true` routes only. Hosts cut calls near 60 s: for long work pass `defer:true` (with `tasks`, one job per item) and poll task_jobs get. Returns: the answer text, its check: lines and response_file (read_response opens the receipt; receipt:"full" inlines it).

job.description: picks the model that fits now and fills prompts and options; your fields win

workflow.description: step-by-step instructions for the local model; implies its job

objective.description: quality needs a task policy or an explicit model

model.description: exact tag; omitted, routing picks by capability only, so name the catalog's pick for the job

fallbackModels.description: tried in order only when the model before was refused before it ran (no room, input over its context, not installed, wrong capability); never after it started. The receipt's fallback lists each attempt

minPlacementEvidence.description: observed: refuse unless /api/ps proves where the model runs

images.description: base64 (prefer `files`). Needs an explicit vision `model`; text in images: the catalog's ocr pick

files.description: paths or globs the server reads (4 MiB per text file, 8 MiB per image, 32 MiB total): text under prompt, images as images; embedding: ~1.5 KB chunks; decision: the state

state.description: decision: the text or JSON the questions are about

questions.description: decision: {name:{type, instructions, criteria}}; choice picks one criteria label, noul is the probability of yes, score a level from 2-10 descriptions

messages.description: Caller system prompts; no injected task instructions. Overrides prompt.

tools.description: Returns tool_calls for you to run; check them, since small models call a tool when none is needed. With `tasks`: a shared default

options.description: num_ctx/num_gpu are routing-owned; num_predict caps output

minConfidence.description: refuse a route graded lower; medium needs a task policy plus a benchmark

maxWaitSeconds.description: capped by the operator's max_queue_wait_seconds; lowered waits show as wait_limit

stopOnRepetition.description: stop a repeating answer, keeping its text

idempotencyKey.description: defer:true on a serve with durable jobs (FREELLAMA_DURABLE_JOBS=1): resubmitting the same key and input returns the original job instead of running it again

output.description: auto (default): inline up to 8,000 chars, else a summary and where the rest is

outputPath.description: also write the answer here as Markdown (inside the readable roots)

dimensions.description: embedding: shorten vectors (models trained for it)

nearest.description: embedding: {query?, top? (default 5, max 100), minScore?, documentPrefix?}: the items closest to `query`, or the most similar pairs

preview.description: Routing only: payload fields and runtime controls are refused; never executes.

tasks.description: independent items; per-item fields override top-level ones; one ## <id> section each

tools.name: task_jobs
tools.description: Use when: following run_task {defer:true} work (jobId is its job_id, or one of accepted_job_ids): list, get (result), cancel, or remove (cancels first) a job. Do not use when: submitting work or killing a session. Returns: the job's status, then its answer, ranking or error as text, then response_file (read_response opens the full receipt).

tools.name: ollama_pull
tools.description: Use when: the user approved downloading one exact tag at its reported size (models{view:"library", model:<family>} lists tags with sizeBytes). Pass that size as approvedSizeBytes: the pull is refused when the tag is unknown or its current size differs by more than 5%. Do not use when: you only found or recommended a model (search is not approval), or the tag is installed. Returns: a receipt with status and progress.

model.description: exact tag, e.g. family:tag or hf.co/owner/repo:quant

approvedSizeBytes.description: the download size the user approved, in bytes

tools.name: ollama_manage
tools.description: Use when: loading or freeing a model. warm loads an installed model before a burst and evaluates an optional systemPrompt/messages into the prompt cache, which later run_task calls reuse only with the same model, contextTokens and an identical systemPrompt/messages prefix; unload frees memory (a model you warmed or the user named). Do not use when: downloading (ollama_pull; action pull is deprecated and refused), deleting (ollama_delete) or searching (models). Returns: a receipt with status.

task.description: warm: runner profile; embedding-only models need none, "embedding" for ones that also complete

contextTokens.description: warm: the num_ctx later calls use

minPlacementEvidence.description: observed: refuse unless /api/ps proves where the model runs

maxWaitSeconds.description: capped by the operator's max_queue_wait_seconds (default 120); lowered waits show as wait_limit

tools.name: ollama_delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE. Use when: a human explicitly names the exact installed tag to delete. Do not use when: you inferred the cleanup yourself, or only want to free memory (ollama_manage unload). Returns: the deleted tag.

tools.name: delegate_research
tools.description: Use when: a read-only question about files under workspacePath (where is X, what calls Y) would take several searches; without `model` it uses the catalog's research-agent pick that is installed and fits now. Do not use when: editing (adapter:"coder" edits an isolated copy, if the operator enabled it), facts outside the workspace (GitHub excepted: adapter:"github", which needs no `workspacePath`), final judgment, or a question one search answers; run_task embedding with `nearest` finds files faster. Up to 8 turns, killed after 180 s by default plus 20 s per GB of model above 4 GB (at most 1,200 s; agent.timeoutSeconds sets it, up to 1,800); no defer (a host that cuts calls near 60 s may drop it). Returns: citations/answer; discard verification.recommendation=escalate, otherwise verify citations. coder: review structuredContent.diff, then run structuredContent.applyCommand.

workspacePath.description: directory to research, under FREELLAMA_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS; absolute, or relative to the server's working directory. Required except for adapter github

adapter.description: bash (default) or octocode search workspacePath; github searches GitHub

receipt.description: compact (default): trail at response_file; full: inline

output.description: auto (default): inline up to 8,000 chars, else a summary and where the rest is

outputPath.description: also write the answer here as Markdown (inside the readable roots)

tools.name: audio
tools.description: Use when: a WAV recording must become text (transcribe, or translate into another language) or text must become speech (speak). `file` is a WAV under the run_task files roots; the model needs audio input (speech for speak): find one with models{view:"catalog", job:"speech-to-text"} ("text-to-speech" for speak); none installed means ask the user to approve a pull. Do not use when: a yes/no about the audio is enough (run_task decision with the .wav in files). Returns: the text, or the WAV path written.

outputFile.description: speak: a new .wav under the readable roots; default temp dir

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Use when: a large divisible check (code tree, logs, docs site) should run chunk by chunk on a local model in the background; each result is saved and you read only flagged chunks. start returns at once; wait (<=50 s) follows it; results pages flagged|unsure (within 0.15 below a flag threshold)|failed|changed|all; resume continues after a restart; `baseline` reuses an earlier sweep for unchanged chunks. Clear chunks are screened, not proven clean: verify flagged ones and treat the rest as unaudited. Do not use when: a few items (run_task tasks), or finding related files (embedding + nearest). Returns: status; results cite path:Lstart-Lend or url#n.

files.description: paths or globs, as run_task files

crawl.description: defaults: true, 20 pages, depth 1; include is a link regex

questions.description: run_task decision questions, asked per chunk; noul flags at p>=0.5

flags.description: when: a choice option or "true"; atLeast: default 0.5

explainPrompt.description: with explainModel: a note per confirmed flag

saveAs.description: results: all of filter to handoffs/<name>.md

tools.name: read_response
tools.description: Use when: a result's response_file holds what the inline view lacks. Do not use when: the inline result answers. Returns: one section (a `sections` name, a structuredContent field or a JSON pointer such as /result/structuredContent/route), paged by offset/limit (characters, array items or JSON text; next_offset continues). Array pages also cap serialized text; an oversized record returns an explicit preview and its record_section to page. Omit section for an outline.
